        *   `icon: string` (required) — icon name to render.
        *   `title?: string` — optional display title.
        *   `urlSuffix: string` (required) — passed to `onClick`.

        *   `condition?: Condition` — optional; renders a condition icon when set.
        *   `selected?: boolean` — when true, click does not invoke `onClick`.

*   Define and export the Condition enum from:
    *   `app/client/packages/design-system/ads/src/Templates/Sidebar/enums.ts`.
    *   Include at least:

*   Ensure the SidebarButton component:
    *   Renders an element with `role="button"` and `data-testid="t--sidebar-{id}"`.

    *   Calls `onClick` with `urlSuffix` when clicked, unless `selected` is true.

**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory. The verification system will apply test patches automatically. Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.

## Summary

I migrated the IDE sidebar navigation button from the application layer into the shared `@appsmith/ads` design system package.

**New files in the design system** (`app/client/packages/design-system/ads/src/Templates/Sidebar/`):
- `enums.ts` — exports the `Condition` enum (`Warn = "Warn"`).
- `SidebarButton/SidebarButton.types.ts` — exports the `SidebarButtonProps` interface with the required fields (`id`, `icon`, `title?`, `urlSuffix`, `onClick`, `condition?`, `selected?`, plus a preserved `tooltip?`).
- `SidebarButton/SidebarButton.tsx` — the `SidebarButton` **named export**. Renders `role="button"` with `data-testid="t--sidebar-{id}"`, a condition indicator carrying `data-testid="t--sidebar-Warn-condition-icon"` when `condition === Condition.Warn`, and calls `onClick(urlSuffix)` unless `selected`.
- `SidebarButton/index.ts` and `Sidebar/index.ts` — barrel exports; wired into `Templates/index.ts` so everything is reachable from the package root.

**Application-layer changes (source only):**
- `IDE/Components/Sidebar/Sidebar.tsx` now imports `SidebarButton`/`SidebarButtonProps` from `@appsmith/ads` and passes `id` instead of `testId`.
- `ce/entities/IDE/constants.ts` — button configs use `id` instead of `testId`.
- `IDE/enums.ts` — re-exports `Condition` from `@appsmith/ads` so the IDE and the shared component share one enum type (avoids nominal-type mismatches).
- Removed the now-orphaned old component directory (`IDE/Components/Sidebar/SidebarButton/`).

Key adaptations from the original: `testId` → `id`, and the condition indicator gained the required `data-testid`. I kept the optional `tooltip` prop because the bottom sidebar buttons rely on it for hover labels — dropping it would have been a regression. I did not touch any `tests/` directory.
